text:
kai: Heads up — bringing up a new HF model and the chat_template -> Redwood conversion produced a role-bleed / role-swap. Anyone seen this?

kai: Jinja snippet:
```
{%- chat_template -%}
- system: |
    You are a helpful assistant.
- user: |
    Summarize the following text:
    {{ text }}
- assistant: |
    {{ summary }}
{%- endchat_template -%}
```

emma: Hmm — what's the converted prompt look like? Maybe our converter is collapsing blank lines or trimming the leading `- assistant` marker.

kai: Converted result:
```
System: You are a helpful assistant.
User: Summarize the following text:
{{ text }}Assistant: {{ summary }}
```

raj: Aha — assistant role got concatenated because the Jinja block left no trailing newline. HF's chat_template preserves list boundaries; our renderer does a `join('
')` without ensuring a separating newline between blocks.

brian: Also check tokenizer special tokens — some tokenizers (and models) use `add_prefix_space` or custom BOS/EOS which changes token boundaries and KV-cache offsets. That can make small whitespace differences alter token counts in surprising ways.

sophia: Seen this before: config.json sometimes has `truncation_side` or `pad_token` defaults that clip system tokens during slicing. That can cause role migration when prompt slicing happens.

kai: Quick repro on the model's tokenizer — token counts differ for the assistant marker: `Assistant: ` vs `
Assistant: `.

kai:
```
> tokenizer.encode('Assistant: ')
[152, 44, 3]
> tokenizer.encode('
Assistant: ')
[198, 152, 44, 3]
```

emma: Yep — missing leading newline reduces token length and allowed the trailing `User` line to be joined to the assistant marker. Fix options:
- ensure `convert_chat_template` inserts an explicit `
` between list items when rendering
- preserve empty assistant message markers as distinct lines (don't strip them out)
- or map HF roles to sentinel-prefixed tokens (e.g., `<|system|>`, `<|user|>`, `<|assistant|>`) so tokenization is unambiguous

raj: Short-term patch: make the converter `item.rstrip() + '
'` for each rendered block so we keep separators. Long-term: add unit tests that compare tokenized boundaries HF -> Redwood for a template corpus.

brian: Also kicked off an eval run — seeing a small quality regression on a couple of prompts (ROUGE down ~1.8, hallucination score slightly up). Likely downstream of the role merge.

eval-bot: eval-run 2026-03-19T15:12Z: 2 prompts failed QA, avg token-length delta +2, hallucination metric +0.12

kai: I'll open a PR to fix the newline joining, add the tokenization boundary tests, and include a smoke eval to detect this class of regressions.

sophia: Thanks — please add a changelog entry and ping eng-oncall if the eval failure persists. :eyes:
